questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: From which location will India export its first locally-built locomotive to the Republic of Guinea in June 2025?
questions.explanation: Marhowrah Rail Factory, Bihar. India’s first locally-built locomotive export to Guinea will be flagged off from Marhowrah Rail Factory.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Who became the first Indian-born academic to be appointed as the Provost of MIT in 2025?
questions.explanation: Anantha Chandrakasan. was appointed as the Provost of MIT, effective July 1, 2025, becoming the first Indian-born academic to hold this role.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the operation launched by India in 2025 to evacuate its citizens from Iran amid rising tensions?
questions.explanation: Operation Sindhu. The mission aimed to evacuate Indian citizens safely from Iran.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which country's highest civilian honour, the Grand Cross of the Order of Makarios III, was conferred on PM Narendra Modi in June 2025?
questions.explanation: Cyprus. The award recognizes exceptional contributions to global peace and diplomacy.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Where is India’s first underwater museum and artificial coral reef being developed using the decommissioned warship INS Guldar?
questions.explanation: Vengurla, Sindhudurg. India’s first underwater museum and artificial coral reef is coming up near Nivati Rocks off Vengurla in Sindhudurg district, Maharashtra, using the decommissioned warship INS Guldar.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which Indian metro has recently been declared the ‘Leopard Capital’ of India due to the highest number of wild leopards living around its outskirts?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru. A year-long survey by the Holematthi Nature Foundation (HNF), led by conservationist Dr. Sanjay Gubbi, found that Bengaluru has an estimated 80–85 wild leopards in its surrounding forests and scrublands. This surpasses Mumbai, making Bengaluru the new ‘Leopard Capital’ of India, a rare distinction for a major metropolis.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which campaign’s second phase was launched by PM Modi on World Environment Day 2025 by planting a sapling in New Delhi?
questions.explanation: PM Modi launched the second phase of the ‘Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam’ campaign on World Environment Day 2025. He planted a sapling at Mahavir Jayanti Park in New Delhi.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which two wetlands from Rajasthan were added to the Ramsar List in 2025, raising India’s total to 91 Ramsar sites?
questions.explanation: Khichan and Menar. India added Khichan and Menar wetlands from Rajasthan to the Ramsar List in 2025.. This brought the country’s total to 91 Ramsar sites, just ahead of World Environment Day.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding the revamped digital platform for coal sector employees: 1. C CARES 2.0 was launched in 2025 to enhance social security services for coal sector workers. 2. CoalSetu was launched in 2025 as the digital platform for real-time coal sector employee services. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only 1. Statement 2 is incorrect – The correct platform name is C CARES 2.0, not CoalSetu.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which Indian state is set to launch the country’s first Mining Tourism Project to highlight its mineral heritage?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand will be the first Indian state to launch a Mining Tourism Project. The initiative is led by the state government and Central Coalfields Limited (CCL). It aims to promote tourism and public awareness of mining practices and local heritage.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which Indian state is setting up a dedicated Hornbill Conservation Centre at the Anamalai Tiger Reserve?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu. The initiative focuses on scientific research, community participation, and ecological restoration to protect threatened hornbill species.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Where was the first campus of the Indian Institute of Creative Technology (IICT) inaugurated to boost India’s AVGC-XR sector?
questions.explanation: Mumbai. The first campus of the Indian Institute of Creative Technology (IICT) was inaugurated in Mumbai to strengthen India’s AVGC-XR (Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comic & Extended Reality) sector.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Where was India’s first Aqua Tech Park inaugurated to promote modern fish farming techniques like biofloc and aquaponics?
questions.explanation: Sonapur. India’s first Aqua Tech Park was inaugurated by Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma in Sonapur, near Guwahati. The park aims to educate fish farmers on modern techniques such as biofloc and aquaponics, helping improve fish production and farmer incomes.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: India’s first RoRo (Roll-on/Roll-off) ferry service was launched in July 2025 on which river?
questions.explanation: Mandovi River. On July 14, 2025, Goa launched India’s first RoRo ferry service on the Mandovi River. The ferries, Gangotri and Dwarka, will ease travel between Chorao Island and Ribandar, benefiting daily commuters, enhancing tourism, and strengthening water transport in the state.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: The Behdeinkhlam Festival, recently celebrated in Meghalaya, is associated with which tribal community?
questions.explanation: Pnars. The Behdeinkhlam Festival is an annual celebration of the Pnars, a tribal community in Jowai, Meghalaya. Held in July, the festival involves prayers for a good harvest, and rituals to ward off diseases and evil, while reinforcing the community’s traditional faith and identity.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which Indian state became the first to join the Cruise Bharat Mission to promote cruise tourism?
questions.explanation: Gujarat became the first Indian state to join the Cruise Bharat Mission, a national initiative aimed at enhancing cruise tourism across India. Announced in Ahmedabad, this move leverages Gujarat’s extensive coastline to develop new cruise circuits and aligns with India’s vision to become a leading global cruise destination by 2029.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding Gingee Fort: 1. Gingee Fort, recently declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is located in Tamil Nadu. 2. Gingee Fort, recently declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is located in Karnataka. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only 1. Statement 2 is incorrect – The fort is not located in Karnataka.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which of the following is the main reason that Prime Minister Narendra Modi meet Mr. Michal Spiczko, President of the Kabaddi Federation of Poland ?

options.a: To congratulate him on Poland's football achievements
options.b: To appreciate his efforts in promoting Kabaddi in Europe
options.c: To sign a trade agreement between India and Poland
options.d: To discuss military cooperation through sports

questions.answer_text: To appreciate his efforts in promoting Kabaddi in Europe
questions.explanation: To appreciate his efforts in promoting Kabaddi in Europe. Poland has been actively promoting Kabaddi, with its national team participating in international tournaments. During his visit to Warsaw, Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with Mr. Michal Spiczko, President of the Kabaddi Federation of Poland, and Ms. Anna Kalbarczy, a board member of the federation. The primary focus of their discussion was to explore strategies for further popularizing Kabaddi in Poland and the rest of Europe. ]

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which country withdrew from the NPT in 2003 and later developed nuclear weapons?
questions.explanation: North Korea. The Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT), signed in 1968, aims to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons. North Korea had joined the treaty in 1985 but announced its withdrawal in 2003, citing U.S. hostility and security concerns. Subsequently, it carried out multiple nuclear tests (first in 2006) and openly declared itself a nuclear-armed state. In contrast, Israel never signed the NPT, Iran remains a member though controversial for its nuclear program, and Syria is also an NPT signatory.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched with India's geopolitical interest?

options.d: SAGAR Policy - Maritime ties in the Indian Ocean

questions.answer_text: SAGAR Policy - Maritime ties in the Indian Ocean
questions.explanation: SAGAR Policy - Maritime ties in the Indian Ocean. The SAGAR Policy (“Security and Growth for All in the Region”), announced in 2015, is India’s strategic vision for the Indian Ocean Region. It emphasizes maritime cooperation, security, blue economy, and partnerships with littoral states to ensure peace and prosperity. The Ashgabat Agreement relates to a transport corridor linking Central Asia with the Persian Gulf, not BIMSTEC. The Kaladan Multimodal Project connects India’s Northeast to Myanmar’s Sittwe port, not Iran. The so-called Ladakh Corridor has no link to Africa.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Who was invited as the chief guest for India's 76th Republic Day celebrations on January 26, 2025?
questions.explanation: Prabowo Subianto. The chief guest at India's 76th Republic Day (January 26, 2025) was President Prabowo Subianto of Indonesia. His visit marked not only a high-profile diplomatic engagement but also saw the first-ever participation of an Indonesian Armed Forces marching contingent and military band in the Republic Day parade.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) is often viewed as a strategic counter-initiative to which other major global connectivity projects?
questions.explanation: Belt and Road Initiative (BRI). The India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) is a strategic connectivity initiative launched at the G20 Summit 2023 in New Delhi through an MoU signed by India, US, Saudi Arabia, UAE, France, Germany, Italy, and the EU. It is part of the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment (PGII), launched by the G7 in 2021. IMEC aims to provide a transparent, sustainable, and debt-free alternative to China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), while safeguarding national sovereignty. The corridor has two segments: Eastern Corridor – India to Gulf, and Northern Corridor – Gulf to Europe.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: The IMEC is envisaged as a multi-modal corridor. Which of the following modes of transport are its primary components?
questions.explanation: Maritime and Rail only. The IMEC primarily uses maritime and rail transport to move goods from India to Europe via the Middle East. Ships carry cargo to the UAE, and high-speed rail transports it across the Arabian Peninsula to Europe, providing a faster, cost-effective alternative to traditional routes like the Suez Canal.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: India's support for which of the following missions aligns most closely with IMEC's purpose?

options.d: One Sun One World One Grid initiative

questions.answer_text: One Sun One World One Grid initiative
questions.explanation: One Sun One World One Grid initiative. IMEC (India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor) was announced during the G20 Summit 2023 in New Delhi. Its goal: To create an integrated transport and energy corridor linking India → Middle East → Europe via rail, shipping, and energy pipelines + green energy transmission lines. One Sun One World One Grid (OSOWOG) is an India-led global initiative that aims to establish a transnational solar power grid for sharing renewable energy across regions. Both IMEC and OSOWOG emphasize sustainable connectivity, renewable energy transfer, and infrastructure integration across continents.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which of the following correctly pairs the initiative with its primary objective from India's viewpoint?

options.a: Chabahar Port - Access Central Asia via Iran
options.c: QUAD - Strengthening oil diplomacy in Gulf
options.d: IMEC - Maritime security in South China Sea

questions.answer_text: Chabahar Port - Access Central Asia via Iran
questions.explanation: Chabahar Port – Access Central Asia via Iran. Chabahar Port (Iran): India is developing this port to gain direct access to Afghanistan and Central Asia while bypassing Pakistan. It is part of India’s strategy to strengthen trade connectivity with landlocked Central Asian nations and Afghanistan. BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation): Objective: Promote regional cooperation among South and Southeast Asian countries around the Bay of Bengal. QUAD (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue): India, USA, Japan, Australia → Focus on Indo-Pacific security, maritime cooperation, emerging technologies. IMEC (India-Middle East-Europe Corridor, 2023 G20): Aim: Enhance connectivity (rail + shipping) between India, Middle East, and Europe.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: A massive 8.7-magnitude earthquake struck which of the following regions on July 30, 2025, triggering tsunami warnings across the Pacific?
questions.explanation: Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia. The 8.7 magnitude earthquake occurred near the Kamchatka Peninsula in Russia (Asia-Europe region). It caused tsunami alerts across the Pacific, including Japan, Hawaii, Alaska, and the U.S. West Coast. Though it was a powerful quake, no major casualties were reported.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which country will be the largest producer of soybean oil in the world in 2025?
questions.explanation: China. In 2025, China ranks as the top producer of soybean oil, producing over 18 million metric tonnes annually. This is due to urbanization, rising incomes, and high demand for processed and fried foods. The top-5 soybean oil producers in 2025 are : China, United States, Brazil, Argentina, India.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding the July 2025 Cambodia border conflict: 1. Cambodia was engaged in a deadly border conflict with Thailand in July 2025. 2. Cambodia was engaged in a deadly border conflict with Vietnam in July 2025. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only 1. Statement 2 is incorrect – Cambodia did not clash with Vietnam during this incident.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: In which country are the first parliamentary elections in decades scheduled to be held in September 2025 after the fall of President Bashar al-Assad?
questions.explanation: Syria. The first parliamentary elections under the new regime between September15 and 20, 2025. These are the first elections since Assad’s overthrow and will take place under a temporary electoral system overseen by interim President Ahmed al‑Sharaa and the High Election Committee.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: India recently extended a ₹4,850 crore line of credit to which neighbouring country as part of its “Neighbourhood First” policy?
questions.explanation: Maldives. This move aims to support key infrastructure and development projects while also easing the Maldives’ financial pressure by reducing its annual debt repayment obligations by around 40%. The assistance reflects India’s strategic commitment to strengthening bilateral ties and enhancing economic cooperation with its island neighbour in the Indian Ocean region.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which country recently announced its decision to recognise Palestine, signaling a diplomatic shift in the Middle East?
questions.explanation: France. In July 2025, France announced it would recognize Palestine in September, becoming the first G7 and UN Security Council permanent member to do so. This move, led by President Emmanuel Macron, marks a major diplomatic shift, signaling support for the two-state solution and influencing broader international recognition efforts.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: After how many years did India resume tourist visas for Chinese citizens in 2025?
questions.explanation: Five years. India halted tourist visa issuance for Chinese nationals in 2020 amid pandemic controls and escalating border tensions. After a prolonged break, visa services were reopened starting July 24, 2025, ending the five-year hiatus and paving the way for renewed travel and tourism links.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which AQI range corresponds to "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups"?
questions.explanation: 101-150. The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a scale used to report the level of air pollution and its associated health risks. The color for the "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups" range (101-150) is Orange. The other ranges correspond to different levels: 0-50 is "Good," 51-100 is "Moderate," and 151-200 is "Unhealthy" for everyone.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which of the following best describes the main objective of the Indo-French Megha-Tropiques satellite mission?

options.a: Understanding convective systems and the water cycle in tropical regions
options.b: Studying polar ice melt and its impact on global sea levels
options.c: Mapping mineral resources in the Himalayan region
options.d: Monitoring ozone depletion over the equator

questions.answer_text: Understanding convective systems and the water cycle in tropical regions
questions.explanation: The Megha-Tropiques satellite mission, launched jointly by ISRO (India) and CNES (France) in 2011, was primarily designed to study the tropical climate system, especially the water cycle and energy exchanges in the atmosphere. Its instruments observed humidity, cloud systems, and precipitation patterns in tropical regions, helping in better climate modeling and monsoon prediction. It was not related to polar ice melt, mineral mapping, or ozone studies.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: SpaDeX mission is related to ______.
questions.explanation: Space docking. ISRO’s SpaDeX (Space Docking Experiment) mission is designed to test autonomous docking between two spacecraft in orbit. This technology is crucial for future space station modules, refueling missions, and deep-space exploration. It helps India build capabilities for long-duration human spaceflight. It is not linked to AI, farming in space, or planetary geology.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which recent mission by ISRO aims to study the Sun from the Lagrange point L1 ?
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1. Aditya-L1 is India’s first solar observatory mission positioned at the Lagrangian point L1. It was launched on September 2, 2023, and successfully inserted into its targeted halo orbit on January 6, 2024. The spacecraft takes 178 days to complete one revolution around L1. It carries four remote sensing payloads—VELC to study the solar corona, SUIT to image the photosphere and chromosphere in near-UV, SoLEXS to observe soft X-rays focusing on solar flares, and HEL1OS to detect hard X-rays in Sun-as-a-star observations.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: How can NISAR provide valuable information for understanding the relationship between fluid injection and earthquake ?

options.a: By tracking changes in ground surface elevation associated with pumping and injection
options.b: By measuring seismic activity in real time
options.d: By analyzing satellite imagery of earthquake damage

questions.answer_text: By tracking changes in ground surface elevation associated with pumping and injection
questions.explanation: NISAR is a joint ISRO–NASA mission and the first satellite to use dual-frequency radar (L-band and S-band) from a single platform. The L-band SAR, developed by NASA, can penetrate forests, ice, and soil for biomass and deformation studies. The S-band SAR, developed by ISRO, is effective in monitoring crops, wetlands, and surface features. It will be launched using India’s GSLV Mk II (GSLV-F16 variant), a three-stage launch vehicle. This mission also marks ISRO’s first use of GSLV to place a satellite in a sun-synchronous polar orbit.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: In collaboration with which country is ISRO developing the Trishna satellite for high-resolution thermal infrared imaging of Earth?
questions.explanation: France. TRISHNA (Thermal infraRed Imaging Satellite for High-resolution Natural resource Assessment) is a collaborative satellite mission between the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the French space agency CNES. The mission aims to deliver high-resolution, frequent thermal imagery of Earth's surface to study the impacts of climate change and improve natural resource management, particularly for water and food security.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the satellite launched by ISRO's GSLV-F09 that was a gift to SAARC nations?
questions.explanation: GSAT-9, also known as the South Asia Satellite, was launched by ISRO's GSLV-F09 on May 5, 2017. It was offered as a gift to SAARC nations (excluding Pakistan) to promote regional cooperation in communication, telemedicine, and disaster support. The satellite symbolized India's leadership in using space technology for regional development.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Who will fly to ISS under Axiom-4 mission in June 2025?
questions.explanation: Shubhanshu Shukla, a Group Captain with the Indian Air Force and ISRO astronaut (Gaganyatri), served as the Pilot on Axiom Mission4 (Ax‑4), the private mission to the International Space Station.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: In 2025, ISRO announced the construction of the "Bharatiya Antariksh Station" project. What is the first module scheduled to be tested under this initiative?
questions.explanation: The first module scheduled to be tested under ISRO's "Bharatiya Antariksh Station" (BAS) project is known as BAS-01. Based on the detailed descriptions, this module is designed to function as an orbital laboratory supporting microgravity research, technology demonstrations, and scientific imaging, while also incorporating essential systems for human presence, such as an Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS), docking mechanisms, and facilities for crew recreation. These features collectively indicate that the primary function of BAS-01 is consistent with an orbital habitation module, providing the foundation for future human activities in space.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is a unique feature of the AstroSat mission operated by ISRO?
questions.explanation: Simultaneous multi-wavelength observations. AstroSat, launched by ISRO in 2015, is India’s first dedicated multi-wavelength space observatory. Its unique feature is the ability to carry out simultaneous observations in multiple wavelengths: Ultraviolet (UV), Visible light (optical), Soft and hard X-rays. This allows scientists to study cosmic objects (stars, galaxies, black holes, neutron stars) in different energy bands at the same time, giving a more comprehensive understanding.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Who will launch the NISAR Earth observation satellite?
questions.explanation: Both NASA and ISRO. NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) is a joint mission between NASA and ISRO. NASA provided the L-band radar, and ISRO provided the S-band radar. The satellite will be launched by ISRO from Sriharikota, India using the GSLV-F16 rocket.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding NASA's TRACERS mission: 1. The TRACERS mission aims to analyze Earth's magnetic defense against solar storms. 2. The TRACERS mission aims to study the soil composition of the Moon. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only 1. Statement 2 is incorrect – The mission has nothing to do with lunar soil; it focuses on Earth's magnetosphere.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What fungal disease does the new pineapple variety resist?
questions.explanation: Fusariosis. Indian researchers have genetically enhanced a native gene in pineapple plants to strengthen their natural defense mechanisms against Fusariosis, a destructive fungal disease.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: On which date and time (IST) is the NISAR satellite scheduled to launch?
questions.explanation: July 30, 2025 at 17:40 IST. The NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite is the first Earth observation mission jointly developed by ISRO and NASA, marking a milestone in Indo-US space cooperation. Scheduled for launch aboard GSLV-F16 on July 30, 2025, from Sriharikota.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding the indigenous malaria vaccine: 1. The indigenous malaria vaccine developed by ICMR is named AdFalciVax. 2. The indigenous malaria vaccine developed by ICMR is named R21/Matrix‑M. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only 1. Statement 2 is incorrect – R21/Matrix‑M is a malaria vaccine developed elsewhere, not by ICMR.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the largest Martian meteorite ever auctioned, which sold in July 2025?
questions.explanation: Northwest Africa 16788 (NWA16788), discovered in the Sahara Desert in 2023, is the largest known Martian meteorite on Earth, weighing 24.5 kg (54 pounds). Its sale at Sotheby’s for $5.3 million set a record-breaking price for any meteorite, marking a major scientific and commercial milestone.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: By which year does ISRO aim to have its own space station operational?
questions.explanation: 2035. ISRO, under the leadership of Chairman V. Narayanan, has unveiled its long-term space vision, which includes setting up an independent Indian space station by the year 2035. This is part of India's broader roadmap that also targets a human moon landing by 2040, reflecting the nation's growing ambitions and capabilities in the global space sector.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which newly discovered lichen species was identified in the Western Ghats on July 19, 2025?
questions.explanation: The discovery of Allographa effusosoredica, a new lichen species in the Western Ghats, emphasizes the ecological richness and scientific significance of this UNESCO World Heritage site. Lichens like this play crucial roles in symbiotic evolution, ecological monitoring, and habitat sustainability, making such discoveries valuable for biodiversity conservation and research.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which institution launched the Gyanodaya Centre for Pedagogical Innovation and Publishing?
questions.explanation: IIM Kozhikode’s ‘Gyanodaya – Centre for Pedagogical Innovation and Publishing’ is focused on reshaping management education by blending traditional Indian knowledge systems with modern teaching methods.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Who is set to become the first Indian astronaut to pilot a space mission to the International Space Station (ISS)?
questions.explanation: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla of the Indian Air Force has been selected as the pilot for Axiom Mission 4 (Ax-4), making him the first Indian to pilot a space mission to the ISS.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the advanced communications satellite launched by Israel on July 13, 2025?
questions.explanation: Dror-1. On July 13, 2025, Israel successfully launched its most advanced communications satellite, Dror-1, into space using SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral, USA. The satellite was developed by Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which country’s scientists have developed the world’s lightest brain controller to guide bees like flying robots?
questions.explanation: China. A team of scientists from China, specifically at the Beijing Institute of Technology, has developed the world’s lightest brain controller that can guide the flight of bees.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the new butterfly species discovered in the Western Ghats of Kerala?
questions.explanation: Zographetus mathewi. This newly discovered species is found in low-elevation forests and is endemic to the Western Ghats. The species is named in honour of George Mathew, a renowned Indian entomologist.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the AI system launched by Microsoft to accelerate protein behavior simulation?
questions.explanation: BioEmu is an advanced AI system that simulates protein behavior in hours, significantly transforming drug discovery and biological research. It was announced by Microsoft Chairman and CEO Satya Nadella as a leap forward in biomedical innovation.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the new tree species discovered in Assam’s Baksa district?
questions.explanation: Garcinia kusumae. This newly discovered tree species was found by senior botanist Jatindra Sarma and named in honour of his late mother Kusum Devi, highlighting Assam’s botanical richness and India’s natural heritage.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the smart AI-based system launched by Andhra Pradesh to control mosquito-borne diseases?
questions.explanation: SMoSS — The Smart Mosquito Surveillance System is an AI-powered initiative launched by the Andhra Pradesh government to monitor and control mosquito populations using drones, sensors, and smart data, beginning in six major cities.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which Hyderabad-based company has received approval to launch India’s first private space-based internet service by 2028?
questions.explanation: Ananth Technologies, based in Hyderabad, has been granted permission by IN-SPACe to launch India’s first private satellite-based broadband service, expected to begin in 2028.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of India’s first automated biomedical waste conversion system launched by AIIMS Delhi ?
questions.explanation: Srjanam. AIIMS Delhi launched Srjanam, developed by CSIR-NIIST, as India’s first automated biomedical waste conversion system, eliminating hazardous waste without incineration.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: On June 25–26, 2025, aboard which private company’s Dragon spacecraft did Shubhanshu Shukla fly to the ISS?
questions.explanation: Dragon Crew (SpaceX). Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla of the Indian Air Force became the second Indian in space after Rakesh Sharma, flying aboard SpaceX’s Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station (ISS) on June 25–26, 2025. This historic mission makes him the 634th human to travel to space.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Where is India’s first Quantum Computing Valley scheduled to be launched by January 2026?
questions.explanation: Amaravati. This ambitious initiative, announced during a workshop in Vijayawada by Katamneni Bhaskar, Secretary, ITE&C, is part of the National Quantum Mission (NQM).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Who became the first Indian to complete NASA’s International Air and Space Program and was selected for a 2029 space mission to Titan's Orbital Port Space Station?
questions.explanation: Dangeti Jahnavi. Hailing from Palakollu in Andhra Pradesh’s West Godavari district, she became the first Indian to successfully complete NASA’s International Air and Space Program.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the advanced AI-powered feature recently launched by Google in India to enhance search experiences through complex queries and multimodal interactions?
questions.explanation: AI Mode. Google has launched its revolutionary AI Mode in India, powered by custom Gemini 2.5, allowing for advanced reasoning, complex query handling, and multimodal interaction to redefine the search experience.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Which automobile company recently conducted a successful launch and landing test of its first experimental reusable rocket in June 2025?
questions.explanation: Honda. The Japanese company conducted the successful test on June 17, 2025, at its facility in Taiki Town, Hokkaido, marking its debut in the reusable rocket technology sector.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Where did Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman lay the foundation stone for a Mini Planetarium and Astro Globe on June 15, 2025?
questions.explanation: Hanle Dark Sky Reserve. The project in the Changthang region of Ladakh was sanctioned under the Special Development Package with an investment of ₹276.65 lakh to boost scientific literacy, astro-tourism, and local employment.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the unofficial name of the COVID-19 subvariant NB.1.8.1, flagged by the WHO as a variant under monitoring?
questions.explanation: Nimbus. The subvariant NB.1.8.1, an Omicron descendant first identified in January 2025, is known for its rapid transmission and the symptom “razor blade throat”, and is currently under WHO watch as a variant of concern.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the primary objective of China’s Tianwen-2 mission launched by CNSA ?

options.c: Collect samples from asteroid 2016HO3 and study a comet

questions.answer_text: Collect samples from asteroid 2016HO3 and study a comet
questions.explanation: China’s Tianwen-2 mission, launched by the China National Space Administration (CNSA), aims to retrieve asteroid samples and later explore comet 311P, enhancing our understanding of solar system formation.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of India’s newly launched indigenous electric aircraft?
questions.explanation: e-Hansa. The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research - National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL) developed the e-Hansa aircraft.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Where has DRDO inaugurated its Advanced Quantum Technology Research Centre (AQTRC) ?
questions.explanation: Delhi. The AQTRC is aimed at developing and promoting indigenous capabilities in quantum computing, quantum communication, and sensing technologies.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the target of China’s Tianwen-2 space mission?
questions.explanation: Kamo’oalewa is a small near - Earth asteroid that exhibits quasi - satellite behavior, staying close to Earth’s orbit.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is Google Beam ?
questions.explanation: Google Beam is an AI-powered 3D video communication platform that transforms standard 2D video streams into immersive 3D experiences, enhancing remote interactions by making them feel more lifelike.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the primary concept behind Google's AI Matryoshka ?

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: How many winning ideas were announced under the 'Ideas4LiFE' initiative?
questions.explanation: 21. A total of 21 winning ideas (top 3 in each of 7 themes) were selected under the 'Ideas4LiFE' initiative promoting sustainable living, launched with UNICEF YuWaah. 7 themes are : Save Energy, Save Water, Say No to Single-Use Plastic, Sustainable Food Systems, Reduce Waste, Reduce E-Waste, Adopt Healthy Lifestyles.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: In which Indian state was the butterfly species Euthalia malaccana recently recorded for the first time?
questions.explanation: Arunachal Pradesh. Euthalia malaccana is also known as Fruhstorfer’s Baron.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of both the GPS and BeiDou systems?
questions.explanation: Both GPS (Global Positioning System) and BeiDou are satellite-based systems that provide global navigation and positioning services. The BeiDou Navigation Satellite System was developed by China as an alternative to the U.S.-owned GPS.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is OpenAI Codex primarily designed to do?
questions.explanation: Automate and accelerate coding tasks. Codex performs its operations within a secure cloud sandbox environment, ensuring safety and isolation during task execution.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: How many total missions had ISRO completed before the PSLV-C61/EOS-09 mission?
questions.explanation: 100. The mission aimed to deploy the EOS-09 Earth observation satellite into a Sun-Synchronous Polar Orbit. The mission failed due to a drop in chamber pressure in the third stage of the rocket.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of the submersible vehicle developed for the Samudrayaan mission?
questions.explanation: Matsya 6000. The Samudrayaan mission aims to explore deep-sea resources and assess marine biodiversity at depths of up to 6,000 meters. The Samudrayaan mission is expected to be launched by the end of 2026.

questions.explanation: DRR Dhan 100 (Kamala). ICAR led the development through advanced biotechnology research.

questions.question: Which critical component did India contribute to the ITER project?
questions.explanation: Cryostat chamber. India contributed the cryostat chamber to ITER, which encases the Tokamak and ensures a super-cold environment. ITER, based in France, is a global project involving 7 members (India, China, USA, Russia, Japan, South Korea, and the European Union), aiming to produce clean, fusion-based energy.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is the name of Amazon's satellite internet initiative ?
questions.explanation: Project Kuiper. On April 28, 2025, Amazon launched 27 satellites for Project Kuiper. The primary goal of Project Kuiper is to provide high-speed, low-latency broadband internet to underserved and remote areas.

questions.explanation: The test aimed to ensure stable ignition and performance at 60% of the rated power level, examining the operation of crucial subsystems like turbo pumps and the pre-burner.

questions.question: What is the official designation of the Bullseye Galaxy ?

options.d: A rise in GNI per capita alone can significantly improve HDI, even with falling life expectancy and education.

questions.answer_text: Despite being discontinued, the Ease of Doing Business report remains influential for investors assessing startup procedures.
questions.explanation: The Ease of Doing Business Report was discontinued in September 2021 due to data irregularities. By 2025, it no longer holds real influence for investors; newer frameworks and indices are being used instead. The World Happiness Report 2024 indeed lists GDP per capita, social support, and healthy life expectancy among the key factors of happiness. An AQI above 200 is classified as very unhealthy, posing risks to all groups and requiring urgent policy response. The Human Development Index (HDI) is a composite of health, education, and income. A rise in GNI per capita alone cannot significantly raise HDI if life expectancy and education fall.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Nelson Mandela International Day is observed annually on which date?
questions.explanation: July 18. This day marks Nelson Mandela’s birthday and is observed globally as Nelson Mandela International Day to honour his legacy of peace, freedom, and justice.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: On which date is the World Day for International Justice observed annually?
questions.explanation: July 17. The World Day for International Justice is observed every year on July 17 to mark the adoption of the Rome Statute in 1998, which established the International Criminal Court (ICC).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: On which date was World Snake Day 2025 celebrated with a conservation awareness event at Bannerghatta Biological Park?
questions.explanation: July 17.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: When is AI Appreciation Day observed in India to celebrate advancements in Artificial Intelligence across sectors?
questions.explanation: July 16. India observes AI Appreciation Day on July 16 to highlight the role of Artificial Intelligence in transforming sectors like healthcare, education, agriculture, governance, and industry. The Digital India mission (2015) and NITI Aayog’s National AI Strategy (2018) provided strong policy frameworks that accelerated AI adoption across the country.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: When is World Youth Skills Day celebrated to promote skill development among youth, especially in AI and digital technologies in 2025?
questions.explanation: July 15. World Youth Skills Day is observed annually on July 15 to emphasize the importance of equipping young people with skills, and in 2025, the focus was on AI and digital empowerment. The United Nations General Assembly declared July 15th as World Youth Skills Day in 2014.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: When is World Population Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: July 11. World Population Day is observed every year on July 11; this traces back to the world population reaching five billion on July 11, 1987.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: On which date was the 125th birth anniversary of Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee observed in 2025?
questions.explanation: July 6. Dr.Mookerjee was born on July6, 1901, so his 125th birth anniversary was commemorated on July6, 2025. The Government declared a two ‑ year nationwide commemoration (July2025 – July2027) honoring his legacy across all states and union territories

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding Guru Purnima 2025: 1. Guru Purnima commemorates the birth anniversary of Ved Vyasa, who compiled the Vedas and authored the Mahabharata. 2. In 2025, Guru Purnima will be observed on July 10. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Both 1 and 2. Guru Purnima is celebrated in honor of Ved Vyasa, and in 2025, it falls on July 10.
